description: Identifies breakouts from Bollinger Band squeezes, confirmed by positive RSI momentum and increasing On-Balance Volume, aiming to capture strong trend initiations.
entry_logic: LONG: CLOSE > BB_UPPER_20_2 AND RSI_14 > 50 AND OBV_DIFF_1 > 0; SHORT: CLOSE < BB_LOWER_20_2 AND RSI_14 < 50 AND OBV_DIFF_1 < 0
